title: Qt: Explicitly connect our "Edit" menu actions.
description:
Use new-style connections for each of our "Edit" menu actions. KDE's
clazy project recommends them over auto-connnections:

https://github.com/KDE/clazy/blob/1.11/docs/checks/README-connect-by-name.md

Use queued connections for the mark, ignore, and other actions that might
run a nested event loop.
Fixes #18344.
